url_len.label: URL length
url_len.desc: Very long URLs are frequently used to hide deceptive destinations or tracking payloads.

domain_len.label: Domain length
domain_len.desc: Abnormally long hostnames often conceal brand impersonations or generated names.

dots.label: Number of dots
dots.desc: Many dots typically indicate nested subdomains or obfuscated path structures.

hyphens.label: Number of hyphens
hyphens.desc: Hyphens are commonly used to craft deceptive brand names (e.g. secure-login-bank).

subdomains.label: Subdomain count
subdomains.desc: Deep subdomain nesting is used to mislead users into seeing a legitimate brand name.

has_ip.label: IP address host
has_ip.desc: Legitimate web services use domain names; direct IP hosts are high-risk indicators.

https.label: HTTPS usage
https.desc: Plain HTTP lacks encryption (though modern phishing frequently adopts free TLS).

keywords.label: Suspicious keywords
keywords.desc: Words like 'login', 'verify', 'account', and 'secure' serve as psychological lures.

entropy.label: Character entropy
entropy.desc: High Shannon entropy indicates random strings, hex tokens, or obfuscation.

bad_tld.label: High-abuse TLD
bad_tld.desc: TLDs known for high rates of registration abuse (.xyz, .top, .tk, .click).

special_chars.label: Special character count
special_chars.desc: Frequency of characters like _, =, ?, &, %, and @ used in obfuscation or tracking.

digit_ratio.label: Digit ratio
digit_ratio.desc: Proportion of numeric digits across the entire URL length.

at_sym.label: '@' symbol detection
at_sym.desc: The '@' character can disguise the true host by placing a deceptive prefix.

is_shortened.label: URL shortening service
is_shortened.desc: Shorteners (bit.ly, tinyurl) mask the actual destination host.

punycode.label: Punycode indicator
punycode.desc: Internationalized domain names ('xn--') used in homograph attacks to mimic letters.

homograph_indicator.label: Homograph indicator
homograph_indicator.desc: Hostname contains Punycode or character mixtures typical of domain spoofing.

suspicious_hostname.label: Suspicious hostname pattern
suspicious_hostname.desc: Patterns such as consecutive hyphens, hex tokens, or multi-brand labels in host.

path_len.label: Path length
path_len.desc: Extended path segments frequently mask redirection scripts or credential harvesters.

query_len.label: Query string length
query_len.desc: Large query strings often contain victim tokens, encoded parameters, or redirects.

url_encoding.label: URL percent-encoding
url_encoding.desc: Frequent percent-encoding (%xx) can be used to bypass simplistic string matching filters.

redirect_params.label: Redirect parameter
redirect_params.desc: Parameters like 'url=' or 'redirect=' commonly signal open redirect exploitation.

path_depth.label: Path subdirectory depth
path_depth.desc: Deep hierarchical directory paths common in staged credential harvesters.
